problem.card2_desc: Constant tool switching drains focus and performance drops by up to 30%.
problem.card3_desc: When information isn't connected, mistakes multiply.

ai_context.heading: AI without context is guesswork.
ai_context.para1: AI can generate impressive answers in seconds. But impressive answers don't run productions. Without full production context, outputs don't connect, decisions don't propagate, and teams fall out of alignment.
ai_context.para2: That's why AI-first tools look powerful, yet still leave productions fragmented. It's also why 95% of companies fail to unlock real AI value.
ai_context.para3: Pzaz connects your full production context so your tools, AI agents and your teams work together in harmony.
ai_context.caption: You're in control while AI assist. The production stays aligned.

script.hero_sub: Pzaz Script transforms any screenplay — from any writing tool — into a production-ready system of data, decisions, and workflows. Built for producers, line producers, and production teams who need scripts that hold up in the real world.
script.hero_trust: Works with Final Draft, Celtx, and industry-standard formats.
script.problem_desc: Scripts arrive as PDFs or Final Draft files. Production begins somewhere else — in breakdowns, schedules, budgets, and spreadsheets.
script.problem_card_title: This is no longer a tooling problem.
script.problem_bottom: The script stops being reliable the moment production starts.
script.shift_title: A script isn't just a document.
script.shift_card4: Remain authoritative from development through delivery
script.shift_bottom: Most tools stop at FADE OUT.
script.promise_sub: Pzaz Script is tool-agnostic, production-first script intelligence. You don't change how writers write. You change how scripts move into production.
script.core_desc: One platform. The complete script lifecycle. Everything your script needs — from the first idea to production — in one intuitive workspace.
script.core_feat1_desc: A complete scriptwriting ecosystem. Brainstorm ideas, draft scripts, and move seamlessly into production planning.
script.core_feat2_desc: Automatic industry-standard formatting. Formatting happens automatically, so you stay immersed in your narrative.
script.core_feat3_desc: Track changes, compare drafts, and restore previous versions instantly. Nothing is ever lost.
script.core_feat4_desc: Co-write and edit scripts live with your team, no matter where they are in the world.
script.ai_desc: Let AI handle the heavy lifting — from formatting and continuity to scene suggestions — so you can focus on telling your story.
script.ai_card1_desc: Automatically formats your script to industry standards as you write, so you never break creative flow.
script.ai_card2_desc: Get contextual scene and dialogue recommendations based on your story's tone, genre, and structure.
script.ai_card3_desc: AI keeps track of character arcs, dialogue patterns, and continuity across your entire script.
script.ai_card4_desc: Receive real-time feedback on pacing, structure, and readability to sharpen every draft.
script.usps_desc: Every feature is designed for producers, line producers, production managers, and executives who need scripts to work in the real world.
script.cta_desc: Your story deserves a tool built for the future. Start writing today — it's free, no credit card required.

budget.hero_pill: Production Budgeting Built for Connected Workflows
budget.hero_sub2: A production budget is not just a financial document. It is a living reflection of scope, timing, and creative intent. When it lives in isolation from the script, breakdown, and schedule, alignment breaks. And when alignment breaks, overruns follow.
budget.problem_title: When Budgeting Lives in a Silo,
budget.problem_desc: Traditional budgeting tools are powerful, trusted, and built to support complex productions. But they often operate as standalone systems.
budget.problem_card_title: Financial insight becomes reactive, not timely.
budget.problem_item1: Budgets live in one place while scripts evolve elsewhere.
budget.problem_item2: Schedules adjust in another system entirely.
budget.problem_item3: Information moves manually between files and departments.
budget.problem_right1: As information moves manually between files and departments, clarity begins to fade. Versions multiply, visibility narrows, and financial insight becomes reactive instead of timely.
budget.problem_right2: This is not a spreadsheet problem. It is a coordination problem.
budget.connected_sub: Pzaz Budgeting sits inside the same environment as your script, breakdown, schedule and production workflow, so the financial picture stays connected to the decisions that shape the film.
budget.connected_highlight: One system, with financial clarity built in.
budget.connected_label: Nothing has to be passed between files
budget.connected_item3_result: the financial implications are already visible
budget.shift_desc: When budgeting lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, behaviour begins to change.
budget.shift_b1: Departments send revised files back and forth
budget.shift_a1: Departments work within the same budget
budget.shift_a2: Producers see cost implications before committing
budget.shift_b3: Forecasts catch up to scope changes later
budget.shift_bottom1: The budget stops being a document that explains what already happened.
budget.shift_bottom2: It becomes a tool that helps shape what happens next instead.
budget.features_desc: Rigorous financial control without requiring budgeting to live in a separate silo.
budget.feat2: Configure ledger structures for accountant compatibility
budget.feat3: Build multi-currency budgets for international productions
budget.feat4: Set taxes, fringes, and regional compliance rules
budget.feat5: Create scenario budgets with structured version control
budget.feat6: Track forecasts against actuals in real time
budget.feat7: Attach documents directly to budget line items
budget.ai_desc: AI can generate numbers quickly, but numbers without context rarely run a production. In Pzaz, AI works within the full coordination of your project — not outside it.
budget.ai_card1_desc: Generate structured budgets directly from breakdown data — no manual re-entry between systems.
budget.ai_card2_desc: AI highlights cost patterns and anomalies so financial risks surface before they become overruns.
budget.ai_card3_desc: Support scenario forecasting with structured comparisons across budget versions and schedule changes.
budget.ai_card4_desc: Accountants remain in control. Producers remain responsible. AI adds speed and structure where it helps.
budget.ai_highlight: Clarity improves, and at the same time, judgment stays human.
budget.legacy_p1: Industry-standard tools like Movie Magic Budgeting have earned their place over decades. They provide deep financial logic and are familiar to line producers and accountants across the industry.
budget.legacy_p2: Pzaz does not try to replace that foundation.
budget.legacy_p3: It simply places budgeting inside the wider production environment. Instead of a financial file moving between specialists, the budget stays connected to the script, breakdown and schedule.
budget.legacy_p4: Financial depth should not require complexity. Legacy budgeting systems are powerful, but they often carry the weight of older software — desktop-bound, training-heavy, and difficult to navigate.
budget.legacy_p5: Pzaz keeps the financial discipline, but removes the friction.
budget.legacy_p6: It delivers the same level of control inside a modern, cloud-based environment where producers, department heads, and accountants can work together without barriers.
budget.cta_desc: When budgeting lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, fragmentation begins to disappear. Creative ambition stays connected to operational reality.
budget.cta_bottom: Run your production in sync. Operate with real financial clarity.
